builds.name: Subjugate ceiling
builds.summary: Subjugate deals (.30+.0002 AP) target max HP over 5s. AP raises percent-health coefficient; MR penetration matters and R MR theft changes resistance during the drain.
builds.goal: Subjugate deals (.30+.0002 AP) target max HP over 5s. AP raises percent-health coefficient; MR penetration matters and R MR theft changes resistance during the drain.
builds.hypothesis:
Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing [0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 + (0.0002) × AP] max Health magic damage and stealing [40]% Armor and Magic Resist over [5] seconds.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

builds.goal: Explore high one King's Tribute recovery inside Frozen Domain output under a finite benchmark; compare alternatives without claiming a solver-certified maximum.

Rune reasoning: Trundle — one King's Tribute recovery inside Frozen Domain: The heal scales with the dead enemy maximum HP, not Trundle AP or own HP. Grasp of the Undying: HP and its proc are utility; they do not scale the dead enemy max-HP healing basis. Font of Life: Separate conditional heal; do not merge it into Kings Tribute. Conditioning: Survival utility only. Revitalize: Test eligible passive self-healing and the real low-owner-HP modifier; record actual recovery. Biscuit Delivery: Finite owner health and separate healing are utility, not a larger dead-enemy HP coefficient. Cosmic Insight: Cooldown utility; it does not increase one passive recovery.

Rune preparation: Recipient is self. Revitalize bonus below 40% is conditional on that recipient at application; do not silently grant it at full HP. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion.

Rune comparison: Keep the dead enemy HP and W state fixed while comparing Revitalize active/inactive and real received-healing modifiers. Do not interpret adaptive AP, Grasp HP or a keystone heal as extra Kings Tribute; no rune page raises the dead enemy HP for this comparison.
